# Real-source regression fixtures

API Reference fixtures are whole pages from `aspose-tex/Aspose.TeX-API-References`
`master` at `bbfcba7dc4681ef244ab3577c6f7c041fae0f4f9` (Java tree last
regenerated for 24.9), under `english/java/`:

- `texjob-real.md`: `com.aspose.tex/texjob/_index.md` (class; three
  constructor overloads, `run`, static `createFormat`).
- `ifilecollector-real.md`: `com.aspose.tex/ifilecollector/_index.md`
  (interface; front matter closes inline with the declaration fence).
- `size2d-float-real.md`: `com.aspose.tex/float/_index.md` (nested type
  `Size2D.Float`; directory keeps only the simple name).
- `tiffcompression-real.md`: `com.aspose.tex.rendering/tiffcompression/_index.md`
  (enum constants as fields).

Documentation fixtures are whole pages from `aspose-tex-mcp/aspose-tex-docs`
`main` at `4443a4a32ef13567d8c260e766250f40cafdc592`, under `en/java/`:

- `latex-to-pdf-docs-real.md`: `developer-guide/conversion/latex-to-pdf/_index.md`
  (two Gist shortcodes, a `text` console-output fence, `{{<section>}}`).
- `supported-file-formats-docs-real.md`: `getting-started/supported-file-formats/_index.md`
  (`{{< emoticons/tick >}}` in a table).

`docs.md` is a minimal synthetic documentation page without Gist shortcodes. A
deployment repository's registration check extracts it through the real worker.

The API Reference revision is also in the current source repository
`aspose-tex-mcp/reference`. The documentation pages are unchanged in
`aspose-tex-mcp/docs` `main` at `75002cc2204be6c10093f297aa67881181603222`.
